description: Search or list Docs in a Workspace (ClickUp Docs v3). Returns matching Docs with their ids, titles and locations. Use to find a `doc_id` by keyword or to browse Docs under a parent. Paginate with `cursor`.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (the `next_cursor` returned by a previous call).

include_archived.description: If true, also include archived Docs. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of Docs to return in this page.

parent_id.description: Restrict results to Docs under this parent container's id.

parent_type.description: Type of the parent container (used together with parent_id).

query.description: Text to search Doc titles/content for. Omit to list all Docs.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: search_docs
